content.title: 2026 Masters Friday tee times: Round 2 groupings
content.text: Bryson DeChambeau continues his quest for a Masters victory on Friday at Augusta National. David Cannon/Getty Images The 2026 Masters continues on Friday, April 10, with the second round at Augusta National Golf Club. You can find full Masters tee times for Round 2 at the bottom of this post.Featured tee time for Round 2Bryson DeChambeau is hoping that this week ends with his third major title and first Masters victory. The two-time U.S. Open champ nearly got the deal done last year, battling Rory McIlroy in Sunday’s final pairing before ceding the green jacket to him.Heading into this year’s Masters, DeChambeau is hot. He’s won the last two LIV Golf tournaments, and he betrayed few nerves at Wednesday’s Masters Par 3 Contest.MASTERS LIVE UPDATES: Follow Round 2 action at Augusta NationalIn Round 1, DeChambeau got started with a textbook par at the 1st, but he didn’t fare as well at the 2nd. Bryson lost his drive on the par-5 into the left woods, eventually settling for a bogey-6 to fall to one over early. But he quickly got that shot back with a birdie a 3.In the end, DeChambeau struggled to a four-over 76 on Day 1. McIlory, on the other hand, is tied for the lead after shooting a five-under 67 at Augusta on Thursday.After starting the opening round early, DeChambeau will switch to the afternoon wave for Friday’s second round.DeChambeau will tee off for Round 2 on Friday at 1:20 p.m. ET alongside Matt Fitzpatrick and Xander Schauffele.You can watch Friday’s second round of the 2026 Masters on TV via ESPN, with coverage scheduled for 3-7:30 p.m. ET. Amazon Prime Video and Masters.com will provide early streaming coverage from 1-3 p.m. ET. You can watch other streaming coverage all Friday long via Masters.com, the Masters app, the ESPN App, Amazon Prime Video, Paramount+ and DirecTV including exclusive early action, featured group coverage and much more.You can check out the complete Round 2 tee times for the 2026 Masters below.2026 Masters tee times for Friday: Round 2 (ET)Tee No. 17:40 a.m. – Samuel Stevens, Sungjae Im7:50 a.m. – Andrew Novak, Tom McKibbin, Brian Campbell8:02 a.m. – Mike Weir, Wyndham Clark, Mateo Pulcini (A)8:14 a.m. – Zach Johnson, Michael Kim, Nicolai Højgaard8:26 a.m. – Danny Willett, Davis Riley, Ethan Fang (A)8:38 a.m. – Adam Scott, Daniel Berger, Brian Harman8:50 a.m. – Fred Couples, Min Woo Lee, Fifa Laopakdee (A)9:02 a.m. – Sergio Garcia, Aaron Rai, Jacob Bridgeman9:19 a.m. – Harry Hall, Corey Conners, Michael Brennan9:31 a.m. – J.J.
